name: Concord University
tuition_note: In-state (WV resident) full-year Tuition & Fees $9,748 from concord.edu/costs Cost of Attendance page (Undergraduate Full Year - In-State and Metro). Housing figure $13,398 is combined on-campus housing + food (room + board); page does not publish a room-only rate. Page states on-campus housing cost is based on the median housing charge incurred during 2024-25; arithmetic confirms: $9,748 tuition&fees + $1,440 books + $13,398 housing+food = $24,586 direct, + $4,754 indirect = $29,340 total on-campus.
